pr_body:
We previously moved external storage init after the sqlServer preStart
to ensure we have a SQL instance ID. Unfortunately, sqlServer.preStart
also started the job scheduler, which may immediately execute a job
that assumes that external storage has been initialized.

This is a minimal fix intended for backport that starts the job
scheduler after we initialize external storage.

Fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/114842

Epic: none

Release note (bug fix): Fix a bug where scheduled jobs using external
storage providers may fail shortly after node startup.

issue_context.title: server: scheduled jobs can startup before external storage is init'ed
issue_context.body:
Scheduled backups fail with `cannot create external storage before init` if they are scheduled to run just around the time of node startup. This was probably introduced in https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/98184/files#diff-104a11712684e520f0affa95e6a053faeb713306a10f69ee99b9729cc9dd1996.

Jira issue: CRDB-33708

review_comments: nit: is this one too many layers of indirection? This init method is not really init'ing anything so maybe we can just move this logic to startJobScheduler? I don't feel strongly so feel free to ignore.

I kinda agree, but to me its kinda ugly either way. Having a function that just calls another function is definitely a bit meh. But then if we move that call inline here we suddenly have a number of more places where we reach into sqlServer's fields directly.
